title: Superpower steps
description: A centred 'how it works' title and lead over four numbered cards: square photos with a small frosted number badge in the corner, then a title and two or three lines of grey text. Four in a tight row on desktop, stacked and centred on phones. Cards fade in and rise 22px one after another as they scroll into view.
notes: on desktop the section is at least 88% of the window tall, content centred, like the original
